title: Xbox’s former COO has ‘serious concerns’ about her abrupt departure

claims.claim: Helen Chiang left Microsoft less than two weeks ago after being promoted to chief operating officer in July.

evidence.quote: Xbox’s former chief operating officer, Helen Chiang, suddenly left Microsoft less than two weeks ago after being promoted into the role in July.

claims.claim: Helen Chiang worked at Microsoft for 21 years.

evidence.quote: I wrote in my Notepad newsletter last week that it seemed very weird for Chiang to suddenly depart Microsoft after 21 years with a surprisingly short memo from Xbox CEO Asha Sharma.

claims.claim: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma sent a short memo regarding Chiang's departure.

evidence.quote: suddenly depart Microsoft after 21 years with a surprisingly short memo from Xbox CEO Asha Sharma.
I wrote in my Notepad newsletter last week that it seemed very weird for Chiang to suddenly depart Microsoft after 21 years with a surprisingly short memo from Xbox CEO Asha Sharma.

claims.claim: Eurogamer reported last month that Chiang had been terminated for policy violations.

evidence.quote: Eurogamer reported last month that Chiang had been “terminated for policy violations,” but she says this is “not accurate.”

claims.claim: Helen Chiang denied rumors that she leaked confidential information or joined a competitor.

evidence.quote: Chiang denies unfounded rumors that speculated she was leaking confidential information, or that she left to join a competitor.

claims.claim: Helen Chiang denied engaging in discrimination, bullying, harassment, insider trading, embezzlement, or other fraudulent activity.

evidence.quote: She also denies engaging in “discrimination, bullying, harassment, insider trading, embezzlement, or other fraudulent activity.”

claims.claim: Helen Chiang stated that she has serious concerns about how standards were applied in her case.

evidence.quote: I have serious concerns about how they were applied in my case, and I believe those concerns deserve to be taken seriously.
